title: Every train in Paris in 24 hours
description:
Every train running in Paris on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Paris city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Métro, RER A, RER B, RER C, RER D and RER E, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 488 trains at 8:46 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable. Île-de-France Mobilités starts its October timetable on October 9, so the earlier days are left out.
